description: Estudio de potencial solar is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Vitoria-Gasteiz. Study of photovoltaic solar potential of the building roofs of the city of Vitoria-Gasteiz. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Vitoria-Gasteiz. The portal shows the English title as "Solar potential study" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Vitoria-Gasteiz. Its keywords include Iturri berriztagarriak, Fuentes renovables. The listing shows 4 download or service links in OCTET-STREAM, PDF. The listing shows 2019-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
